**The shipped workflow stops calling a script the installer never ships (#1094)**

Both MANAGED workflows moved from bare 'repo:check' to 'brain:repo:check': .github/workflows/governance.yml:128 and brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml:140. The issue named only the first; the GitLab site is the same defect reaching the same consumers, found by sweeping every managed workflow before touching a line. MANAGED_SCRIPT_KEYS was deliberately left alone - the 'brain:' namespace is canonical since #961 and the bare names are repo-only aliases. The class is closed by a drift guard, brain/scripts/lib/managed-workflow-script-drift.test.mjs, which discovers managed workflows from 'managed' in managed-paths.mjs rather than a hardcoded list, parses both the GitHub 'run:' shape and the GitLab chained shell-list shape, and allows 'npm test' through a named ALLOWED_TEST_SCRIPT constant instead of a silent regex gap. Mutation-verified: reverting either call site makes the guard fail naming that file:line. Known limit, documented in design.md: a dynamically built 'npm run' invocation is invisible to a text scan; no managed workflow does that today.
